model: AXIS Camera Station S1148 64 TB Recorder
aliases: AXIS Camera Station S1148 140 TB Recorder
series: AXIS Camera Station S11 Recorder Series

storage.built_in: S1148 64 TB: 64 TB (8x8 TB) hot-swappable Enterprise Class HDD, 56 TB after factory RAID 5, 4 free slots. S1148 140 TB: 144 TB (12x12 TB), 120 TB after factory RAID 6. 240 GB SSD operating system drive

power.supply: 2 x 750 W hot-plug redundant power supplies (100–240 V AC, 10–5 A, 50/60 Hz)

features: 48 AXIS Camera Station core licenses included
Qualified for up to 64 video channels and 128 doors
Not intended for local viewing of video; AXIS desktop terminals recommended
notes: Record covers the S1148 64 TB and S1148 140 TB variants. weight_g is for the 64 TB variant; datasheet gives 22.3 kg (64 TB) and 26.5 kg (140 TB).
Datasheet states the 140 TB variant used 14x10 TB drives before Q2 2020.
